catalog.source: User-supplied processed IROPS candidate tables; public de-identified release authorized by repository owner
catalog.transform: Replace all original identifiers by monotone anonymous labels; shift all UTC departures by a common whole-day offset; replace raw CVM by supplied normalized CVM
catalog.preserved: Party sizes, candidate membership, scenario features/costs, flight/cabin incidence, capacities, relative times, 12-hour grouping, priority order/ties and deterministic label tie-breaking
catalog.priority_units: Normalized CVM, unitless; captured priority is not raw client CVM
catalog.scope: PNRs in the supplied candidate catalog; original impacted/no-candidate PNR population and upstream itinerary generation remain external

input_audit.ranking_boundary: Supplied normalized features are preserved; original-journey segmentation and feature quality are external to this solver

config.execution: Classical simulated annealing using neal; no quantum hardware or quantum annealing execution
config.input_boundary: Precomputed candidate journeys and normalized features; upstream itinerary construction and Gurobi baseline remain external

connection_audit.scope: All supplied flights and feasible cabin patterns; at most two stops, no airport cycles. The prototype transfer threshold is not an airport-specific commercial MCT certification.

fingerprint_type: sha256 of canonical uncompressed instance JSON v1
